options.title: Cost of Living
options.description: We all know that the price of everything has increased. I will work to ensure that we are lowering the tax burden and eliminating junk fees (e.g., car registration, gas appliance tax) that cost our families thousands of dollars a year.

options.title: Housing
options.description: Making Maryland a place where people want to live. I will work to create legislation that gives young, first-time homebuyers a property tax exemption in Baltimore City for 3 years.

options.title: Utility Prices
options.description: My opponents have sat idly by and have taken campaign donations from BGE. I will work to ensure that utility prices are untaxed and hold BGE accountable for increasing prices. I will also work to create more nuclear power generation in our state.

options.title: Crime
options.description: While there have been some promising signs, crime is still prevalent and pervasive across our city. I will work to ensure that we enforce all laws, small to large, and let criminals know that Baltimore is not going to tolerate crime.

options.title: Taxes and State Budget
options.description: Our leaders have taxed and spent Maryland to death. I will work for a balanced budget, slash wasteful spending and bloated government, and lower income taxes by 20% by 2030 to help the middle class live the American dream.

options.title: Education
options.description: I will work to ensure that our teachers are properly compensated, that we have enough social workers in our schools, and that our city school administration can’t continue to line their pockets and waste hundreds of millions of dollars.

options.title: Local Infrastructure
options.description: I will work to fix our existing infrastructure by repairing the Hanover Street Bridge immediately, improving our bus services, building bus stop shelters, and financing the Key Bridge.

options.title: Maryland Campaign Finance Reform
options.description: My opponents have taken hundreds of thousands of dollars from corporate and mega-donors. I will work to create legislation that eliminates non-individual donations.

options.title: Maryland Democracy Reforms
options.description: I will work for reforms in our electoral system, including term limits for the Maryland House and Senate, open primaries so everyone has a voice, and ranked-choice voting that makes our elections more representative.

options.title: Maryland Congressional Gerrymandering
options.description: I will fight the Democratic Party's efforts to rig the maps for its benefit, rather than for the benefit of Marylanders or democracy.
